name: Spread Informer v1.02
summary: This EA monitors and displays spread statistics on the chart, including current, maximum, minimum, and average spread values. It alerts the user when the current spread exceeds a configurable threshold, with a minimum interval between alerts to avoid spam. Upon deinitialization, it prints all collected spread statistics to the Journal for Strategy Tester analysis.
summary_zh: 该EA监控并在图表上显示点差统计信息，包括当前、最大、最小和平均点差值。当当前点差超过可配置阈值时发出警报，并设有最短警报间隔以避免频繁打扰。在去初始化时，会将所有收集的点差统计信息打印到日志中，便于策略测试器分析。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个点差监控工具。它不执行任何开仓或平仓操作，仅收集和展示点差数据。入场条件不适用，因为该工具不会入场交易。出场条件同样不适用。仓位管理和资金管理均不涉及，因为没有任何交易行为。其核心功能是在每个tick更新时记录当前点差，跟踪最大、最小和平均值，并在点差超过用户设定的阈值时触发警报。警报机制包含最小间隔控制，防止频繁触发。在图表可视化模式下，所有统计信息实时显示在图表左上角；在策略测试器中，去初始化时会将统计结果输出到日志。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a spread monitoring utility. It does not execute any opening or closing of positions, only collects and displays spread data. Entry conditions are not applicable since the tool does not enter trades. Exit conditions are similarly not applicable. Position sizing and money management are not involved as there are no trading activities whatsoever. Its core functionality updates spread statistics on every tick, tracking the maximum, minimum, and average values, and triggers an alert when the spread exceeds a user-defined threshold. The alert mechanism includes a minimum interval control to prevent spamming. In visual chart mode, all statistics are displayed in real-time on the chart; in the Strategy Tester, statistics are output to the Journal upon deinitialization.

parameters.name: MaxSpread_
parameters.description: 最大点差阈值（点数），超过时触发警报，0表示关闭
parameters.description_en: Max spread threshold (points); alert when exceeded, 0=off

parameters.name: SpreadAlertInterval_
parameters.description: 最短警报间隔（秒），防止频繁触发警报
parameters.description_en: Minimum alert interval (seconds) to prevent frequent triggers

pros: 实时监控点差，为交易决策提供重要参考信息
警报机制设计合理，包含最小间隔防止频繁打扰
策略测试器中可输出历史点差统计，便于回测分析点差影响
代码简洁明了，资源消耗极低
pros_en: Real-time spread monitoring provides valuable reference information for trading decisions
Well-designed alert mechanism with minimum interval prevents alert spam
Outputs historical spread statistics in Strategy Tester for analyzing spread impact on backtests
Clean and minimal code with very low resource consumption
cons: 无图表对象绘制，仅使用Comment()函数，显示效果粗糙且无法自定义样式
平均点差计算使用简单累加，长时间运行可能导致浮点精度问题或溢出
不支持将统计数据保存到文件，去初始化后信息仅存在于日志中
最小点差初始值为0，首次tick逻辑依赖_MinSpreadTime<=0的判断，边界处理可改进
cons_en: No chart object drawing, uses only Comment() which produces crude display with no customizable styling
Average spread uses simple accumulation, which may cause floating-point precision issues or overflow over long runtimes
No file export for statistics; after deinitialization, data exists only in the Journal log
Initial minimum spread value is 0, relying on _MinSpreadTime<=0 check for first-tick logic, which could be improved
improvements: 使用图表对象（如OBJ_LABEL或OBJ_RECTANGLE_LABEL）替代Comment()，实现更美观的自定义界面
采用滑动窗口或指数加权平均计算平均点差，避免长时间运行的精度和溢出问题
增加将统计数据保存到CSV文件的功能，便于离线分析和长期跟踪
improvements_en: Replace Comment() with chart objects (OBJ_LABEL or OBJ_RECTANGLE_LABEL) for a more polished and customizable visual interface
Use sliding window or exponentially weighted moving average for spread calculation to avoid precision and overflow issues during long runtimes
Add CSV file export functionality for statistics to enable offline analysis and long-term tracking

risk_points: 该工具不执行任何交易操作，无资金风险
长时间运行可能导致_AveSpread累加溢出，影响统计准确性
risk_points_en: This tool executes no trading operations, posing no financial risk
Long runtime may cause _AveSpread accumulation overflow, affecting statistical accuracy
